description: We are building "The Last Transmission," an interactive 3D web experience telling the untold stories of NASA's forgotten rovers, landers, and equipment across the Moon and Mars. Users explore planetary globes, view AI-generated 3D models, and decode final transmissions. Looking for passionate Web Developers (Three.js/React), 3D/AI Artists (Meshy/Blender), and Creative Writers/Storytellers to join us and bring space history to life!
